description: Call first in every session (an agent passes agent, e.g. "qa", to see the handoffs addressed to it first). Returns a briefing of where work stopped (unfinished plans, last QA results, recent decisions, last handoff, checkpoints) plus the workspace root and detected stacks.

agent.description: The agent role making this call (e.g. "dev", "qa", "e2e"), so its work is attributed to it. Defaults to HEXACORE_AGENT.
